title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1970-09-19
taper: DAT from "3 Decades of Dead" Tree
source: SBD > Reel(0) > DAT > Mac (via Lucid PCI24) > CD-R

ai_review.summary: Good audience recording with solid sound that shines on the second set, highlighted by Morning Dew, Easy Wind, a monster Dark Star → St. Stephen stretch and an uplifting Turn On Your Love Light.
ai_review.review: The show is praised as a classic early‑70s Dead concert with a patient‑requiring first set but a second set that “must‑have,” featuring extended jams and enthusiastic audience interaction. Recording quality is described as OK overall, improving dramatically from the Dark Star onward, making the music’s power come through clearly.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review highlights an excellent performance and generally good recording (especially the second set), justifying a high rating despite limited data points.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall sound quality is okay, with early‑set issues due to equipment trouble; from Dark Star onward the tape sounds amazing and clear enough to enjoy the long jams.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A classic 1970‑era set list that builds into extended second‑set jams; the audience is highly engaged, and the show rewards patience with memorable improvisations.
